svg.title: Known-best packing of 259 unit squares
svg.desc: The retained known-best n=259 construction, normalized to Witness/v2 and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete exact configuration over a number field of issue 639 at 7d1407a, the upstream gzip retained in the packet and bound to the SHA-256 its manifest pins; each square's basis computed here exactly in the field from the form's half-angle tangent and quarter turns. Decided here on sqpack exact_verify over the witness's field, beside the source's own checker run unchanged (T-193's replay); no second route over a number field is maintained. Finite construction feasibility only; an exact form of a packing others found, with no novelty, priority, local minimum, rigidity or global optimality claim.

svg.text: U n=259 known best: side ~ 16.59137815 (certified upper bound)
